implementation: active shortlist (up to 3) -> grounded suitability assessment -> independent semantic guard -> up to 1 PM with application boundaries
generalization: No case IDs, dataset answer values or incident-specific rules in retrieval; reusable six-field PM unchanged; 8 initially unseen cases included among 28.
protocol_note: The 28-case replay preceded bounded format-repair hardening. Three catalog-object selections were rechecked separately; a further URL case replay with final protocol passed. Separate runs are not pooled as a retrieval accuracy estimate.

planner_checks.result: Planner locates the final alert before extracting its IP; does not confirm seed IP.
Planner retrieves NetworkMessageId from known URL, then plans recipient lookup. Follow-up task has empty refs because that schema was not in supplied PM.
Planner includes ProcessCommandLine matching for script, then resolves the actual process; does not equate script with executable only.
Planner queries known account within relevant time range to investigate source IP.

limitations: No SQL or final-answer accuracy evaluation in these runs.
Semantic decisions remain model-based; structural/source/field checks and an independent guard reduce but cannot eliminate misclassification.
Small diagnostic sample and targeted reruns do not establish a general accuracy gain.
